name: my board
_dsp: optional: DSP slices on the FPGA (needed by kernel_plan.py)
_lut_ff: optional: LUTs and flip-flops on the FPGA (kernel_plan.py then also keeps the kernel within them)
_clock_mhz: optional: kernel clock in MHz (kernel_plan.py assumes 50 when missing)
_mem_gbps: optional: peak external memory bandwidth in GB/s (kernel_plan.py then warns when memory limits the speed)
_max_ports: optional: how many weight ports (independent AXI connections to the memory) the kernel may use, 1 to 4; kernel_plan.py assumes 1 when missing
